prompt: A small flying construct made of riveted brass and oxidized steel plates, its body bristling with outward-jutting razor blades like a metal sea-urchin, hovering airborne in a black night sky. A brilliant white-gold lantern-core glows at its center, the single source of light in the scene, casting hard light across its sharp metal edges and throwing the construct into a glowing silhouette. The background is a deep starless night with faint cloud.

A flying construct seen in side profile, banking through pale grey storm cloud, its wings formed entirely of fanned-out polished steel sword-blades catching cold light along their honed edges. The body is a compact core of riveted brass with a small glowing amber signal-light. The blades splay like a peacock fan of razors. The background is overcast sky with layered grey cloud and a break of pale light behind it.

A flying construct shaped like a hovering lighthouse-tower of bladed brass and weathered iron, its tapered body ringed with jutting razor spikes, airborne above a dark stone fortress wall at night. From a brazier at its top burns a brilliant beacon flame, the only source of light, casting a guiding cone of warm light down over the battlements. The background is a night sky and the dim silhouette of castle ramparts below.

A hovering mechanical construct the size of a lantern, a riveted iron sphere fringed with a radiating ring of fixed steel razor-blades like a spoked sawblade halo, floating in midair. Its central glass eye blazes with brilliant white-blue signal light, the only light source, glinting off every honed blade edge. Sharp lens flare from the core. The background is a dim industrial vault of dark stone, lit only by the construct itself.

A flying construct in side profile gliding through grey cloud, its outstretched wings built from overlapping flat steel sword-blades, each wing a fan of riveted metal razors rather than feathers, edges glinting hard and cold. The compact brass torso houses a single glowing cyan beacon-lamp. Rigid metal tail of bladed plates trailing behind. The background is overcast daytime sky with banded grey storm cloud.

A flying construct hovering high in the open night sky, a riveted iron orb fringed with a radiating halo of fixed steel razor-blades like a spoked sawblade. Its central core blazes with brilliant white-gold beacon light, the only light source, throwing hard glints along every honed blade and lighting the tops of clouds far below it. The background is a deep night sky with stars and a layer of distant moonlit cloud beneath the floating machine.

Low worms-eye view looking steeply up at a flying construct silhouetted against a pale dawn sky, a bladed brass sentinel-machine bristling with downward-pointing steel razor spikes, hovering directly overhead. A blinding beacon-lamp at its underside shines a cone of white light straight down toward the viewer. The background is a brightening dawn sky of soft peach and grey, with thin high cloud around the dark hovering machine.

A compact flying construct hovering in open sky, a round riveted iron core encircled by a tight radiating crown of short steel razor-blades like a spoked sawblade halo, perfectly centered. The core blazes with a brilliant white-gold beacon light, the only light source, hard glints running along each honed blade edge. The background is dim twilight sky with a thin band of cloud well below the floating machine, so it clearly hangs in the air.

Low worms-eye view looking up at a flying bladed construct hovering against a pale dawn sky, a dark brass sentinel-machine ringed with sharp steel razor spikes radiating outward, a glowing amber core at its center. A blinding white beacon-lamp on its underside casts a clean cone of light straight down toward the viewer. The background is a brightening dawn sky of soft peach and grey with thin high cloud framing the dark hovering machine.
